title: Priv control-plane provisioning fabric: composable Terraform kit for EKS
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Scope: Build a reusable, composable Terraform module ("priv-controlplane-fabric") to provision Redwood Private control planes on EKS. The module should: be idempotent, include preflight validations, wired upgrade hooks (drain/evict/rollback patterns), emit healthcheck metrics, integrate with customer KMS for secrets, and expose clear inputs for networking (cross-account VPC peering, route tables), RBAC and audit logging. Deliverables: module code, unit/integration terraform tests, a staged canary rollout runbook, upgrade playbook, and Console dashboards for control-plane health.

Background: Customers running Redwood Private require predictable and safe control-plane upgrades and a terraform-first IaC experience to match our Dedicated workflow. Previous tickets explored operator-based approaches — we are standardizing on a Terraform-native kit to reduce operational surface area while providing opinionated canary/rollback patterns.

Out-of-scope: underlying worker node lifecycle (handled by separate nodepool module), application-level backup/restore, and edge routing automation.

Design links: Confluence design: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Priv+Controlplane+Fabric, initial spec PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-modules/pull/1234, spike notes: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1spike-notes
acceptance_criteria: Module can create a baseline control-plane in a staging account (Terraform v1.5, AWS provider v5.x) with sane defaults and explicit inputs for VPC/region/account
Preflight validations run in 'plan' stage and fail-fast for misconfigurations (missing routes, KMS unreachable, excessive IAM policy size)
Upgrade hooks implement canary->steady->rollback stages and there is an automated rollback path if control-plane health metrics cross thresholds
Healthchecks emit Prometheus-compatible metrics (controlplane_api_latency, controlplane_component_status) and are visible in Console dashboards
Module is idempotent across repeated applies and has >=90% code coverage for unit tests and at least one cross-account integration test
Runbook exists for manual mitigation steps and an automated playbook for scheduled upgrades
Security review completed and audit log events are surfaced to customer KMS/Audit destinations
tasks: Create module skeleton, input schema and example usage: priv-controlplane-fabric/main.tf + variables.tf + README.md
Implement EKS control-plane resources and RBAC bootstrap (IRSA roles where applicable)
Add preflight plan-time validations (custom null_resource checks + external data validations)
Integrate KMS wrapping for secrets and provide example KMS key alias configuration
Wire upgrade lifecycle hooks and a canary orchestration script (terraform + small runner lambda)
Add Terraform tests: unit (tftest) and an integration canary in staging account
Add Prometheus metrics exporters and Console dashboard wiring for health metrics
Write runbook, upgrade playbook, and step-by-step docs for solutions engineers
Submit code review PR, address feedback, and merge with release tags

notes: Tradeoffs: Terraform-only approach keeps surface area small and leverages existing infra CI, but complex orchestration (canary + rollback) requires a small helper runtime (lambda runner). We accept that tradeoff to avoid a long-lived operator. Monitor for drift and consider operator if drift cases increase.
